note: Real shipments confirmed, but the declared HS code 845710 (machining centres for working metal) does NOT match the actual cargo: every observed record is woodworking machinery — HS 84659100 (sawing machines for wood), 84659400 (edge banding), 84669390 (CNC router parts), 84659990, 84144010 (air compressor). Per project rule 3 the company is retained and the code corrected to the factual one: primary HS 8465 (woodworking machinery), with 8466/8414 as secondary. Role is manufacturer_trader: it both imports machines/parts from Chinese suppliers (QINGDAO ZHONGCHI MACHINERY 105 shipments, QINGDAO WEICHANG 7, SHENYANG FULUNTE 6, QINGDAO JIEYONGSHENG 5) and re-exports to Nepal and Saudi Arabia. Note the claimed industry "Металлургия и горнодобыча" (metallurgy & mining) is also wrong — actual line of business is woodworking/furniture machinery. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). Caveat: volza, eximpedia and trademo free views returned HTTP 403, so cross-verification of the 101-shipment figure was not possible; the two export B/L numbers above are as rendered by ImportKey and were not independently re-confirmed.
